snippet.title: Ktrl Smash Gameplay | Fast Multiplayer Arena Battles
snippet.description:
Ktrl Smash is a fast, chaotic multiplayer arena brawler where every second matters. Jump into a bright 3D arena, pick your fighter, and battle players from around the world in short, intense matches.

Grab whatever you can find, baseball bats, balls, chairs and turn them into weapons. Each match is packed with movement, surprises, and split-second decisions. Stat boosts like speed, damage, and health are scattered across the map, and every pickup can spark a fight.

Matches are quick, unpredictable, and full of action. When the timer hits zero, the player with the most smacks wins and takes the crown.
